Reheats well

Base Quinoa / wild rice + greens.

Vegetables Mushrooms, tomato, roasted cauliflower.

Fruit / pickle Pickled onion.

Herbs Sage + parsley.

Crunch Walnuts.

Sauce Sherry-sage pan juices.

Herb shorthand: parsley is universal; dill suits fish, tuna and cucumber; mint suits Mediterranean bowls, mango, pomegranate, cucumber and feta; Mexican mint / Cuban oregano is mint-forward in this kitchen, so use sparingly with Mexican bowls, corn, beans, turkey, mushrooms, cucumber and feta. Sage suits poultry, mushrooms, squash and Brussels sprouts. Basil suits tomato, tuna, white fish, zucchini and peach. Scallion suits Asian and spicy bowls.
Keep the greens crisp. Dress at serving.Tonight’s bowl
